pr_title: Some small fixes for the Matter light platform
pr_body:
## Proposed change

- add fallback discovery schema for devices with wrong or missing devicetype (e.g. tasmota devices)
- add guard when minlevel or maxlevel brightness is not reported by device (e.g. tapo switches)
- add guard when  ColorCapabilities attribute is missing on device

Been looking into the matter 1.1 spec for this problem and I believe the minLevel/maxLevel values are capped between 1 and 254.

From the spec:

> A value of 0x01 SHALL indicate the minimum level that can be attained on a device.
A value of 0xfe SHALL indicate the maximum level that can be attained on a device.

Also I think the _set_brightness method is going to need the same fix as well.

Thanks.
> Been looking into the matter 1.1 spec for this problem and I believe the minLevel/maxLevel values are capped between 1 and 254.

Good catch! That said you now already know the tapo device is not behaving according to spec ;-)
Actually your fix is probably the right solution as the MinLevel and MaxLevel  attributes are optional with defaults of 1 and 254 respectively.

In the image LT refers to the lighting feature for the default value of 0 but I'm assuming we wouldn't be down in the light module at this point if it didn't support it.

![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/7027990/9265aaca-2409-4fcf-803f-a594e62527c1)
> Actually your fix is probably the right solution as the MinLevel and MaxLevel attributes are optional with defaults of 1 and 254 respectively.

Changed it to 0 for minLevel and 254 for maxLevel now.
